node.title: Rate-half MCA support-wise affine-span compiler (refuted)
node.statement: The claim that local pair noncontainment preserves the affine-span MCA incidence bound is false. Over RS[GF(1009),{0,...,99},1] at agreement 21, 31 direction-separated slopes have exact pair-noncontained maximal supports and explanations of affine rank one, while the asserted bound is 23. Local full incident rank does not imply the proper-subspace occupancy bound needed for the ordered-basis product. All small-dimension payments sourced from this node are retracted.
